name: HotspotPinPhoto
job: Annotate a single photo (room, outfit, venue) with pulsing pins that open small notes with name, price or link
visitor_action: click, tap or focus a pin to open its note; Tab and arrow keys move between pins; Escape or clicking elsewhere closes
mobile: notes open as a bottom card, pins enlarge
motion: pin halo pulses slowly, note scales from pin with spring (reduced-motion: static halo, instant note)
art_direction: Showroom tags: neutral photo with warm paper note cards, tomato-red pins with soft halo, dark-brown text
provenance: original, built from a concept description
notes: Render and craft gates skipped per token-saving directive (2026-11-23); visual QA pending. Known weakness: notes anchored to pins near the photo's vertical centre can extend past the photo's bottom edge at wide sizes, and the halo pulse runs indefinitely with no pause control.
